[[2022 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] champions |tourney=[[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] |tourney_result = Final Four }} {{2021–22 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2021–22 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team''' represented [[Villanova University]] in the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. Led by head coach [[Jay Wright (basketball)|Jay Wright]] in his 21st and final year of coaching, the Wildcats played their home games at the [[Finneran Pavilion]] on the school's campus in the [[Philadelphia]] suburb of [[Villanova, Pennsylvania]] and [[Wells Fargo Center (Philadelphia)|Wells Fargo Center]] as members of the [[Big East Conference]]. They finished the season 30–8, 16–4 in Big East play to finish in second place. They defeated [[2021–22 St. John's Red Storm men's basketball team|St. John's]], [[2021–22 UConn Huskies men's basketball team|UConn]], and [[2021–22 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Creighton]] to win the [[2022 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] championship. As a result, they received the conference's automatic bid to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 2 seed in the South region. They defeated [[2021–22 Delaware Fightin' Blue Hens men's basketball team|Delaware]], [[2021–22 Ohio State Buckeyes men's basketball team|Ohio State]], [[2021–22 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team|Michigan]], and [[2021–22 Houston Cougars men's basketball team|Houston]] to advance to the Final Four. There they lost to eventual national champion [[2021–22 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]]. On April 20, 2022, head coach Jay Wright announced he was retiring effective immediately.{{Cite web |title=Villanova coach Jay Wright steps down, joining growing number who are walking away from a changing profession |url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/villanova-coach-jay-wright-steps-down-joining-growing-number-who-are-walking-away-from-a-changing-profession/ |access-date=2022-04-21 |website=CBSSports.com |language=en}} Former Wright assistant and [[Fordham Rams men's basketball|Fordham]] head coach [[Kyle Neptune]] was named the new head coach.{{Cite web |date=2022-04-20 |title=Wright retiring after 21 years as Villanova coach |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/33775177/villanova-jay-wright-retire-head-coach-kyle-neptune-take-over |access-date=2022-04-21 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}} ==Previous season== In a season limited due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, the [[2019–20 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Wildcats]] finished the [[2020–21 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|2020–21 season]] 18–7 overall and 11–4 in Big East play to finish first place in the conference. As the No. 1 seed in the [[2021 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]], they lost in the quarterfinals 72–71 to eventual conference tournament champions [[2020–21 Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball team|Georgetown]].{{Cite web|last=Juliano|first=Joe|title=Top seed Villanova upset by Georgetown, 72–71, in Big East quarterfinals|url=https://www.inquirer.com/college-sports/villanova/villanova-wildcats-upset-loss-georgetown-hoyas-big-east-tournament-20210311.html|access-date=2021-07-07|website=www.inquirer.com|language=en}} In the [[2021 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], the Wildcats received the 5 seed in the South Regional. They defeated [[2020–21 Winthrop Eagles men's basketball team|Winthrop]] and [[2020–21 North Texas Mean Green men's basketball team|North Texas]] to reach the Sweet 16, where they fell to eventual tournament champions [[2020–21 Baylor Bears basketball team|Baylor]] 62–51.{{Cite web|title=NCAA Tournament 2021: No. 1 seed Baylor rallies in second half vs. Villanova to move on to Elite
